question.text: Sub-brokers as an intermediary ceased to exist from which date as per SEBI decision?

explanation.text: The Logic: SEBI Board decided on June 21, 2018 that sub-brokers shall cease to exist from April 01, 2019, with existing sub-brokers migrating to become Authorised Persons (APs) or Trading Members. The Trap: June 21, 2018 was the decision date, not the effective date; January 01, 2020 is not the cessation date. Note: September 28, 2015 relates to the FCRA repeal and the commodity-derivatives regulatory transition; the source pages do not tie that date to a "SEBI takeover" framing.
